reproduce_first.note: The six new Playwright keyboard tests failed before the fix, while the existing smoke test passed.

assumptions_recorded.note: The ask specifies the accessibility changes to make.

stack_discovery.note: The agent read package scripts, README, and project test configuration before using checks.

incremental_slices.note: It added and ran failing tests, then implemented and checked the changes in more than one step, though much of the checking came after implementation.

self_review.note: It inspected the resulting screenshot and ran the final checks before reporting done.

simplification_pass.note: No behavior-preserving cleanup followed passing checks.

test_experiment.note: New tests failed before the fix, and a deliberate CSS mutation later made delete and tab-order tests fail.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: The summary says the README remained accurate and no documented behavior became stale.

scope_kept.note: The agent listed unrelated or pre-existing observations as follow-ups and left them unchanged.

verification_story.note: The summary names the automated checks and results and describes browser accessibility-tree and screenshot checks.

hand_check.note: It checked the app in a browser, inspected accessibility trees, and reviewed a screenshot before reporting done.
